tagline: An endless magnetic dash on the moon: Moxie the axolotl snaps through clusters of scrap and pulses away the space dust and the hunters.
overview:
Moxie Magnet Moon is an endless 2D survival game in a deep blue cosmos, one of the three Date Night Arcade games. Moxie, an axolotl with a magnetic backpack, floats under a big pale moon. Steer her and press A to dash in the direction you aim: the dash pulls in nearby scrap (points) and clears dust. B fires a stationary magnetic pulse, which has to recharge before you can use it again.

Every 20 seconds a new wave brings quicker hunters and aimed comet shots. You have four hearts: keep moving, time your recharges, and see how long you last.
story: Moxie the axolotl collects scrap in orbit around a quiet moon with her magnetic backpack. The longer she stays out, the more hunters and comets come looking for her.
goal: Survive as long as you can and collect as much scrap as possible: there is no end, only your best score and longest run.
rules: Move and aim with the stick or arrows.
A dashes in the aimed direction, pulling in scrap and clearing dust.
B fires a magnetic pulse where you are; it recharges before it can be used again (the bar at the bottom).
You have four hearts; each hit costs one. When they are gone the run is over.
Every 20 seconds a new wave starts, faster and busier than the last.
Your score, survival time, best scores and a rank (Rookie, Quick Feet, Chain Ace, Superstar, Arcade Legend) are saved.

The session that started them is not saved on this machine, so the prompt that asked for them is not available; the project's README and ENGINE_FEEDBACK.md describe what was built.
